ownership: Shared ExecutionContext cell claims retain actual state/record and original storage/member identities; duplicate connected/reserved cells reject across linked/concurrent banks
validation: Validate claims and endpoint before updates/disconnect, recheck after clock capture, stage each bank update before publication; retain uncertain claims on mismatches
effects: Timer operations count as direct/transitive formal/global writes; handler-retained timer aliases block later declared counters; ordinary private counter escape and readonly/value rules remain
archive: Protect saved original claimed cells even for transient/unattached states or changed endpoints; ordinary protected status and atomic archive failure remain
progress: Checkpoint model only; explicit RETURN/DISCONNECT sample after waits, implicit unwind adds no tick or clock read
persistence: Data/services only; no claims, frame ownership, callbacks or suspended execution restored
boundaries: No other-frame disconnect, native alias/ABI/timing inference, cross-context coordination or public strict-mode equivalence
